description: Plenary sittings, agendas, votes and voters. Mode sittings lists a year's sittings. Mode agenda_items lists a sitting's published agenda, from the 2024-12-16 sitting on (and the weeks of 2023-07-10 and 2024-04-22): debate, vote and urgency-vote items in agenda order with type, title, heading, time slot, procedures and documents; it changes until the sitting, and a moved item changes ID. Mode vote_items lists a sitting's PLENARY_VOTE_RESULTS vote items with title, documents, procedures and decision_count (absent before 2024, whose vote items link no decisions); pass a vote_item_id to decisions. Default mode decisions pages compact decision summaries of sitting_id, filtered before paging by document_id (exact ID or hyphen-boundary descendant), vote_item_id (a vote_items row or a procedure's PLENARY_VOTE_RESULTS event) or label_contains. label_contains, in decisions or vote_items, matches a literal substring of decision labels (report citations, amendments) or vote item titles, ignoring case, repeated whitespace and dash style without altering published text or establishing a final vote; in a decision label a document_ids entry is cited with its prefix and term joined and the year after the number, so A-9-2022-0116 is A9-0116/2022 and the joint motion RC-9-2022-0257 is RC-B9-0257/2022. Mode decision returns one rich record with reference text and commentary; breakdown adds its recorded voters by political group and country from the sitting-date roster, values that go back to euparl_search_meps with that mandate_date. mep_id in decisions or decision returns recorded and intended positions; empty positions do not prove absence from the vote. Mode voters pages one position of decision_id; a missing array returns available false, a published empty one available true. resolve_names needs roster_term and joins names from that term roster only, never voting-date affiliations; some IDs stay unresolved. Continue with page.next_offset and snapshot; after snapshot_changed, restart at offset 0 without it.

breakdown.description: Decision mode only; default false. True adds breakdown: recorded favor, against and abstention voters tallied by the political group and country published for each on the sitting date (the euparl_search_meps roster for that mandate_date), one extra request. A decision that does not publish all three recorded voter arrays (a hand vote), whose arrays name no person, or an unreadable roster returns no breakdown, with a notice.

decision_id.description: Decision and voters only (required): returned decision ID, eli/dl/event/ prefix or public event URI.

document_id.description: Decisions only: canonical ID, eli/dl/doc/ prefix or public URI in any case, or a citation such as A9-0188/2023, P9_A(2023)0188, T9-0138/2024, B9-0163/2024 or RC-B9-0163/2024. Matches decided-on, part-of or recording relations by exact ID or hyphen-boundary descendant, before paging.

label_contains.description: Decisions or vote_items: literal substring of the selected-language label, ignoring case, repeated whitespace and dash style, before paging. Decision labels carry report citations and amendment numbers and combine with document_id and vote_item_id; in a decision label a document_ids entry is cited with its prefix and term joined and the year after the number, so A-9-2022-0116 is A9-0116/2022 and the joint motion RC-9-2022-0257 is RC-B9-0257/2022. Vote item labels are titles. A match does not establish a final vote.

language.description: EU ISO 639-1 language, any case; default en; text is never translated.

limit.description: Items per page; default 20. Local collections return every requested row, with no output-size cap. Caps: 1000 sittings; a larger limit narrows to the cap with a notice.

mep_id.description: Decisions or decision: numeric person ID, person/ prefix or public person URI. Reads published arrays, no roster join; empty positions do not prove absence from the vote.

mode.description: decisions (default) pages compact summaries; sittings lists a year's; agenda_items and vote_items list those of sitting_id; decision returns one rich record; voters pages one position.

resolve_names.description: Voters only; default false. True joins names from the roster_term roster.

roster_term.description: Term 0–10 holding the sitting; required with resolve_names, else forbidden. Never inferred from dates.

sitting_id.description: Required outside sittings: YYYY-MM-DD, MTG-PL-YYYY-MM-DD, event prefix or public event URI.

snapshot.description: Snapshot returned by an agenda-item, vote-item, decisions or voters page; required above offset 0.

vote_item_id.description: Decisions only: MTG-PL-YYYY-MM-DD-VOT-ITM- ID, eli/dl/event/ prefix or public event URI, from a vote_items row, a vote_item_ids entry or a procedure's PLENARY_VOTE_RESULTS event. Selects every decision of that vote item; its date must match sitting_id.

name: euparl_get_plenary_votes

agenda_items.description: agenda_items mode page, in numeric agenda order; time slots are not rows.

items.description: One agenda item: a debate, vote or urgency vote foreseen at the sitting.

activity_type.description: Published activity type: def/ep-activities/PLENARY_DEBATE, PLENARY_VOTE or REQUEST_VOTE_URGENCY (vote on a Rule 170 urgency request).

agenda_item_id.description: Agenda item ID, such as MTG-PL-2026-11-24-OJ-ITM-V-69; changes when the item moves to another sitting; not a vote_item_id.

document_ids.description: Documents the item is based on (proposal, report, motions), in published order; empty when unpublished.

heading.description: Published group heading, only on grouped items such as Rule 150 human-rights debates and Rule 170 urgency votes.

order.description: Published agenda position as a string such as 9.0; rows sort by its numeric value.

procedure_ids.description: Procedures the item is scheduled for, in published order; empty when unpublished, as on Explanations of votes.

start_time.description: Start of the agenda time slot listing the item; absent when no slot lists it.

available.description: Whether the source array was published; a published empty array counts.

breakdown.description: With breakdown true, once the roster is read: recorded voters tallied by group and country on the mandate_date roster, never current affiliations. Per position, each table plus that position's unmatched voters equals voter_counts; intended corrections are left out.

countries.description: One row per country, by voters descending then code; the row without country last.

country.description: ISO alpha-2 country as that day's roster publishes it (GB for United Kingdom members); pass it to euparl_search_meps as country with mandate_date. Absent on the row of voters listed without a country.

mandate_date.description: Sitting date whose roster supplied groups and countries; pass it as euparl_search_meps mandate_date.

political_groups.description: One row per group, by voters descending then label; the row without political_group last.

political_group.description: Group label as that day's roster publishes it, such as S&D, Verts/ALE, GUE/NGL or The Left; pass it to euparl_search_meps as political_group with mandate_date for its members. Absent on the row of voters listed without a group.

unmatched_mep_ids.description: Recorded voters missing from that roster, once each in first-recorded order, in no row; euparl_get_mep reads them.

abstention.description: Published abstentions; absent stays absent, zero stays zero.

against.description: Published votes against; absent stays absent, zero stays zero.

attendees.description: Published attendees; absent stays absent, zero stays zero.

document_ids.description: Documents decided on, in published order; empty when unpublished.

favor.description: Published votes in favor; absent stays absent, zero stays zero.

mep_position.description: mep_id lookup over the whole decision; intended corrections never replace recorded positions.

intended.description: Membership in one recorded or intended set of voter arrays.

availability.description: published: all three arrays exist; unavailable: none; otherwise partial.

positions.description: Positions listing the member, conflicts kept; empty does not prove absence from the vote.

unavailable_positions.description: Unpublished positions; published empty arrays remain available.

recorded.description: Membership in one recorded or intended set of voter arrays.

availability.description: published: all three arrays exist; unavailable: none; otherwise partial.

positions.description: Positions listing the member, conflicts kept; empty does not prove absence from the vote.

unavailable_positions.description: Unpublished positions; published empty arrays remain available.

method.description: Published method; voter availability is not inferred from it.

order.description: Published decision order, as a string.

outcome.description: Published outcome; never computed from tallies.

partial_document_ids.description: Documents only part of which this decision decided on (one split vote on an amendment), in published order; empty when unpublished.

recording_document_ids.description: Documents recording this decision, in published order; empty when unpublished.

vote_item_ids.description: Vote items this decision belongs to, in published order; empty when unpublished.

voter_counts.description: Counts for published voter arrays only; a missing entry means unavailable. Zero means the array names no person (published empty, or only entries without an ID, which a notice discloses).

items.description: Count of one published voter array.

count.description: Person IDs in this voter array, without entries naming no person; not the published tally.

position.description: Recorded position, or intended (a correction kept separate from recorded votes).

decision_id.description: Normalized decision ID in decision and voters modes.

abstention.description: Published abstentions; absent stays absent, zero stays zero.

against.description: Published votes against; absent stays absent, zero stays zero.

attendees.description: Published attendees; absent stays absent, zero stays zero.

document_ids.description: Documents decided on, in published order; empty when unpublished.

favor.description: Published votes in favor; absent stays absent, zero stays zero.

availability.description: published: all three arrays exist; unavailable: none; otherwise partial.

positions.description: Positions listing the member, conflicts kept; empty does not prove absence from the vote.

unavailable_positions.description: Unpublished positions; published empty arrays remain available.

recorded.description: Membership in one recorded or intended set of voter arrays.

availability.description: published: all three arrays exist; unavailable: none; otherwise partial.

positions.description: Positions listing the member, conflicts kept; empty does not prove absence from the vote.

unavailable_positions.description: Unpublished positions; published empty arrays remain available.

method.description: Published method; voter availability is not inferred from it.

outcome.description: Published outcome; never computed from tallies.

partial_document_ids.description: Documents only part of which this decision decided on (one split vote on an amendment), in published order; empty when unpublished.

recording_document_ids.description: Documents recording this decision, in published order; empty when unpublished.

vote_item_ids.description: Vote items this decision belongs to, in published order; empty when unpublished.

items.description: Count of one published voter array.

count.description: Person IDs in this voter array, without entries naming no person; not the published tally.

position.description: Recorded position, or intended (a correction kept separate from recorded votes).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_filter`: An identifier, date, year, term or language is unsupported, or vote_item_id is from another sitting date. `invalid_mode_fields`: Mode fields are missing or incompatible, or local continuation lacks a snapshot. `snapshot_changed`: The selected collection changed since the supplied snapshot. `decision_not_found`: The decision is absent from the sitting. `upstream_paging_stalled`: A roster, vote-results or agenda read came back incomplete. `upstream_rejected`: Parliament rejects the validated request. `upstream_rate_limited`: Parliament rate limiting outlasts the retries. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Publication, language fallback, empty-result or continuation guidance.

page.description: Page of the selected collection; absent in decision mode.

has_more.description: True when more matches exist or cannot be ruled out.

limit.description: Effective page size after caps and the search window.

next_offset.description: Offset of the next page; absent at the search-window boundary even when has_more is true.

snapshot.description: Pass back with next_offset to continue this local collection.

sitting_id.description: Normalized sitting ID; absent in sittings mode.

totalCount.description: Exact total; only when published or counted over the whole collection.

truncated.description: True when this page holds only part of the collection.

vote_items.description: vote_items mode page, in published order; roll-call, split and separate-vote requests are left out.

items.description: One PLENARY_VOTE_RESULTS vote item: one agenda item voted at the sitting.

decision_count.description: Decisions the vote item links; absent, never 0, where it links none, as before 2024.

document_ids.description: Documents the vote item is based on (report, motions), in published order; empty when unpublished.

procedure_ids.description: Procedures of the vote item, in published order; empty when unpublished.

recording_document_ids.description: Documents recording the vote item (its minutes item), in published order; empty when unpublished.

vote_item_id.description: Vote item ID; pass it as vote_item_id in decisions mode.

voter_resolution.description: Name-resolution provenance and counts; names do not prove spelling or affiliation on the voting date.

resolved.description: Voters resolved across the whole position, before paging.

scope.description: Always parliamentary_term; no historical affiliation is joined.

unresolved.description: Voters without a roster name across the whole position, before paging.

voters.description: Voters mode page for one position, in published ID order.

mep_id.description: Voter person ID, kept when unresolved.

name.description: Name from the roster_term roster; absent means unresolved, not an absent voter.
